paragraphs: Motive sells fleet software and hardware as one integrated suite built around AI. The buyers are commercial fleets, which the company describes as ranging from five or ten vehicles up to companies running thousands of them.

On the safety side, cameras and AI flag more than twenty kinds of event on the road. High-confidence events go straight to managers, while a safety team reviews the low-confidence ones to remove false positives. Vehicle tracking uses real-time GPS with traffic updates and weather overlays for route planning. Compliance work such as electronic logs, driver qualification, IFTA and CSA sits in the same platform. Equipment monitoring shows what share of the time an asset is in use and how long it sits dormant. Telematics from various equipment manufacturers is centralized in a single platform.

The company points to operations running from waste services to construction. It says it was named number one in fleet management across every segment. It also cites top rankings for equipment monitoring in G2 asset tracking reports for summer 2026. Its fleet card is issued by Sutton Bank under a license from Mastercard International.

quote.text: AI that makes your operations safer and more efficient.
